title: Process-tree tests should cover the server-only fallback on Linux kernels without pidfds
outcome: The codex_delegation_process_tree tests run on every Linux build and require the delegation's descendants to exit. On a kernel without pidfd_open (for example 4.19) the documented production fallback ends only the server, so both tests fail there. Gate the full-tree assertions on the containment capability, and verify the server-only fallback when it is unavailable.
acceptance: On a Linux kernel without pidfd_open the process-tree tests assert the server-only fallback instead of the full-tree outcome, and on kernels with pidfds they keep asserting the full tree.
